titles.name: First Vassal
titles.flavor: The first of the eight to trust you completely.

titles.name: Seven Days
titles.flavor: A quest a day for a week. The Protocol noticed.

titles.name: The Long Month
titles.flavor: Thirty days with at least one quest done.

titles.name: The Long Season
titles.flavor: Ninety quest-days. The seasons changed and you were out in them.

titles.name: Hundred Quests
titles.flavor: One hundred quests settled in the Ledger.

titles.name: Pathfinder
titles.flavor: Sixty Move quests. Pell says you are nearly fast now.

titles.name: Dawn Walker
titles.flavor: Twenty-five Outside quests. Wren has stopped checking whether you came back.

titles.name: Steward's Apprentice
titles.flavor: Forty Clean quests. Ondra has handed you a spare clipboard.

titles.name: Herald
titles.flavor: Twenty Social quests. Tobi has you on the broadcast schedule.

titles.name: Scholar of the Stairwell
titles.flavor: Forty Study quests. Imre has shelved you under 'promising'.

titles.name: Night Warden
titles.flavor: Forty Sleep quests. The lights go off by themselves now.

titles.name: Quartermaster's Favourite
titles.flavor: Forty Eat quests. Basil keeps a plate warm for you.

titles.name: Scrubbed Spotless
titles.flavor: Forty Hygiene quests. Marisol has named a towel after you.

titles.name: Keeper of the Lights
titles.flavor: Power at full for seven days in a row.

titles.name: Wall-Holder
titles.flavor: Four waves held. The walls are mostly habit.

titles.name: Decisive
titles.flavor: Three decisive wins in a row.

titles.name: Cartographer
titles.flavor: The Floor is registered. Wren has redrawn the map.

titles.name: Smith of Odd Things
titles.flavor: Ten combo items forged. Ondra is proud and slightly worried.

titles.name: Full Table
titles.flavor: All eight vassals at sixty loyalty or more at the same time.

titles.name: Returned
titles.flavor: You used a Resurrection token. Coming back counts.

titles.name: Open Door
titles.flavor: A vassal left and you welcomed them back. The door was never locked.
